# OPT-1.3B

Meta · released 2022-05 · 1.3B params · opt-175b-license-noncommercial

**score 19.7** ±1.1 · #574 of 598 · from 13 benchmark results across 2 sources

## How the score was worked out

Each result below implies a score on its own, after adjusting for how hard that test is and who ran it. The model's score is their weighted average. Tests that separate models cleanly and agree with the other tests weigh more. A small pull toward the middle keeps thinly tested models from swinging too far. [Method](../method.md)

## How to run it

<sub>[context source](https://arxiv.org/abs/2205.01068v4): Training sequence length stated by the maker; no separate serving limit is published.</sub>

<pre>
download       size  score
4-bit fp16  ~2.63GB   19.7
</pre>

```sh
# 4-bit fp16
uv run --with torch --with 'transformers<5' python -c "from transformers import pipeline; print(pipeline('text-generation', model='facebook/opt-1.3b')('Once upon a time', max_new_tokens=40)[0]['generated_text'])"
```

<sub>The score is the published model's; quantized downloads haven't been evaluated separately.</sub>
